# jamfplatform_pro_clear_passcode (Action)

Clears the passcode on an iPhone or iPad. If the device already has this command waiting, Jamf Pro queues no second copy.

This action targets one device. Use `for_each` to cover several devices.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Jamf lists this under **Platform environment** scope. You choose an integration's scope when you create it in Jamf Account, and cannot change it afterwards. The provider names the scopes it accepts when you configure it, and for a few families that is wider than Jamf lists here. Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Device actions | Device actions | Execute | `device-actions` |
| Inventory | Devices | Read | `devices` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "jamfplatform_pro_clear_passcode" "reset" {
  config {
    serial_number = "F2LXXXXXXXXX"

    # Leave unlock_token out and Jamf Pro looks it up from the device's inventory.
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `management_id` (String) Jamf Pro Management ID of the iPhone or iPad. This is the `id` reported by the `jamfplatform_devices`/`jamfplatform_device` data sources. Set exactly one of this or `serial_number`.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number of the iPhone or iPad (case-sensitive). Set exactly one of this or `management_id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `unlock_token` (String) Unlock token for the device. When you leave this out, the action reads it from the device's inventory in Jamf Pro. This value appears in Terraform plan output, so supply it from a variable or secret store rather than committing it.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `invoke` (String) How long the action may run before it is cancelled, as a duration such as `30s` or `10m`. Defaults to 5 minutes.
